records.text: Candace Owens said the FBI plane left Richmond at 9:50 a.m., reached Salt Lake City at noon, and departed one hour later.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's all. Could be nothing. But it leaves Richmond, Virginia at 9.50 a.m. It gets into Salt Lake at 12 p.m. and then it departs Salt Lake just an hour later.

verification.notes: No authoritative or independently accessible historical flight record located confirms the asserted Richmond departure, Salt Lake City arrival, or one-hour turnaround times for the alleged FBI aircraft.

records.text: Owens said Foster Curtiss left NCIS on June 2, 2025, after 21 years to become Richmond, Virginia's interim inspector general.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Then a strange thing happened on June 2nd, 2025. ... Foster Curtiss, after 21 years, decided to leave his position as a division chief and to be Richmond, Virginia's interim inspector general.

verification.notes: Richmond's official legislative record confirms Foster Curtiss was appointed interim inspector general on June 2, 2025, and public professional records place him at NCIS immediately beforehand. The sources reviewed do not independently establish that June 2 was his exact NCIS departure date or that his service lasted exactly 21 years. The appointment and career transition are supported; exact duration and departure wording are not.

records.text: Owens said Richmond fired inspector general James Osuna after six years, declined comment on the personnel matter, and unusually required nondisclosure agreements.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Richmond, Virginia just fires the inspector general who was there, James Asuna, who had been in that position for six years. ... They were told, quote, no comments will be made on personnel matters. And NDAs were signed unusually.

verification.notes: Independent local reporting confirms Richmond City Council removed James Osuna after nearly six years, officials gave no public reason and treated it as a personnel matter, and the separation agreement contained broad nondisclosure and nondisparagement provisions. The statement is materially accurate.

sources.title: Richmond City Council fires Inspector General James Osuna
sources.relevance: Local public-media reporting on Osuna's removal after nearly six years and the lack of a stated reason.

sources.title: Richmond cut a deal to get its inspector general to leave. It's so secret, officials can't even say it exists.
